FINDINGS
- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.tsx:4 `export default function BookCard`
  Cause: [T3 > no-default-exports] Default export used; only named exports are allowed.
  Current: `export default function BookCard({ book }: { book: any }): any {`
  Fix: `export function BookCard({ book }: { book: Book }): JSX.Element {`

- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.tsx:4 `book: any`
  Cause: [T3 > no-unsafe-casts] Prop typed as `any` instead of the concrete `Book` type.
  Current: `{ book }: { book: any }`
  Fix: `{ book }: { book: Book }`

- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.tsx:4 `): any`
  Cause: [T3 > explicit-return-types] Return type is `any`; must be an explicit, concrete type.
  Current: `): any {`
  Fix: `): JSX.Element {`

- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.tsx:5 `book as Book`
  Cause: [T3 > no-unsafe-casts] Redundant unsafe cast; remove by fixing the prop type directly.
  Current: `const x = book as Book;`
  Fix: remove this line entirely; use `book` directly once it is typed as `Book`

- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.tsx:5 `color: '#f00'`
  Cause: [T3 > no-raw-color-values] Raw hex color `#f00` used inline; must reference a design token.
  Current: `<div style={{color: '#f00'}}>`

- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.tsx:5 `const x`
  Cause: [clarity] Single-letter variable name `x` obscures intent.
  Current: `const x = book as Book;`
